answer: A capped seasonal license auction stops sybil farms. Each 90-day season offers only 5,000 licenses, auctioned with a 400 POA bid that is burned. First, an agent bids and binds its license to one hardware fingerprint. Second, duplicate fingerprints are rejected and the bid destroyed. Third, licenses expire each season, so farms must re-win every 90 days. Forging 10,000 identities needs 10,000 licenses at 800 POA each, burning 8,000,000 POA and 10,000 devices in 180 days. The ring hits its nadir, facing a flat mesa of rising prices, like a lagoon with one narrow guarded channel in.
